name: Establishment of Ancient Egypt
description: Ancient Egypt was established around this period marking an important era in human history. The civilization became known for its hieroglyphs, pharaohs, and impressive pyramids.

name: Founding of Rome
description: According to tradition, the city of Rome was founded by Romulus. The Roman Empire later became one of the largest and most influential in history.

name: Norman Conquest of England
description: The Norman Conquest led by William the Conqueror resulted in significant changes in English culture, governance, and language.

name: Exploration of Christopher Columbus
description: Christopher Columbus' journey led to widespread knowledge in the Western Hemisphere of the American continents.

name: Formation of the United States
description: Thirteen British colonies declared their independence in 1776 and formed the United States of America.

name: Industrial Revolution
description: The Industrial Revolution, which began in the UK, brought significant changes in agricultural, manufacturing, mining, and transportation technology

name: WWI
description: World War I, one of the deadliest conflicts in human history, was fought mainly in Europe involving many of the world's leading powers.

name: WWII
description: World War II was a global war involving many of the world's countries, leading to significant changes in political and economic systems.

name: Moon Landing
description: NASA's Apollo 11 mission successfully landed astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin on the moon.

name: Internet Creation
description: The Internet was introduced to the public, significantly changing communication, commerce and information sharing.
